## Problem

When a file is imported from Google Drive through the Google Picker
(`@uppy/google-drive-picker`), the upload works but its size is unknown:
the progress events reach the client with `bytesTotal: null` and the
status bar shows "780 KB of unknown" with no percentage.

## Cause

`streamGoogleFile`
(`packages/@uppy/companion/src/server/provider/google/drive/index.ts`)
already fetches the file metadata through `getStats`, and `size` is part
of `DRIVE_FILE_FIELDS`. But it only returns the size that
`prepareStream` reads from the `Content-Length` header of the download,
and Google doesn't send that header for `alt=media` downloads.

The picker controller
(`packages/@uppy/companion/src/server/controllers/googlePicker.ts`)
calls `startDownUpload` with `getSize: undefined`, so the `Uploader`
ends up with no size at all. The regular providers don't hit this
because `controllers/get.ts` passes a `getSize`.

## Fix

In `streamGoogleFile`, when the download has no `Content-Length`, fall
back to `Number(stats.size)` if it is a finite number greater than 0.
Google Workspace files are excluded (`isGsuiteFile(mimeType)`): they are
exported, so their metadata has no fixed size that matches the bytes we
stream. A `Content-Length`, when there is one, still wins.

Tests are in `test/google-drive-stream.test.ts`: the metadata fallback,
`Content-Length` taking precedence, and Google Workspace exports staying
unknown. The first one fails without the fix.

## How we verified it

We have been running this change as a local patch on Companion 7.2.0 in
our staging environment. With 11 images uploaded through
`@uppy/google-drive-picker` 2.0.0, the status bar went from "780 KB of
unknown" to "397 KB of 1.2 MB, 32 %", and the total stayed correct for
the whole upload.

Locally: `yarn typecheck` and `yarn check` pass. In the Companion tests,
`test/auth-callback.test.ts > memory auth callback > keeps the result
when a socket closes before subscription completes` times out on my
machine, but it also fails on `main` without this change.

## Possible follow-up on the client

On the client, `mapPickerFile`
(`packages/@uppy/core/src/companion-client/googlePicker.ts`) sets `size:
null`, so the file has no size before the upload starts either. We
worked around that in our frontend by asking Drive for `fields=size`.
That could be another improvement, probably as part of #5532 ("Improve
Google Picker").
